name: Oscar
description: Oscar encompasses two pioneering research paradigms: (1) Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training for Vision-Language tasks (ECCV 2020 by Microsoft & UW) using object tags as anchor points for cross-modal alignment, and (2) OSCAR (Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics by Peking Univ/NVIDIA) fine-tuned on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B for policy evaluation across diverse robot embodiments.
keyFeatures: Object Tag Semantic Anchoring (V+L): Uses detected object tags as explicit anchor points in word-tag-region triplets to bridge vision and language modalities
Multi-Task Cross-Modal Objectives: Pre-trained with Masked Token Loss and Contrastive Loss over 6.5M image-text pairs
Omni-Embodiment Robotics World Model (OSCAR-2B): Action-conditioned video world model for virtual robot policy evaluation across multiple embodiments
Unified Kinematic Skeleton Conditioning: Uses 2D skeleton rendering to generalize control across Franka Panda, KUKA iiwa, AgiBot G1, Toyota HSR, and MANO human hands
SOTA Vision-Language Performance: Sets state-of-the-art benchmarks on COCO Image Captioning, VQA v2.0, Image-Text Retrieval, GQA, and NLVR2

benchmarks.name: COCO Image-Text Retrieval (Text R@1 / Image R@1)

institution: Microsoft Research, University of Washington, Peking University, NVIDIA
curatorNotes: Verified dual-reference entry covering both Microsoft/UW Oscar (Vision-Language Object-Semantics Aligned Pre-training, ECCV 2020) and Zhuoyuan Wu et al. OSCAR (Omni-Embodiment Action-Conditioned World Model for Robotics based on Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B).
